+from tinydb import TinyDB, Query
+import os
+
+def reproduce_memory_storage():
+    print("Testing MemoryStorage...")
+    db = TinyDB(':memory:')
+    User = Query()
+    
+    # Insert a document
+    doc_id = db.insert({'name': 'John Doe', 'age': 30})
+    
+    # First query
+    results1 = db.search(User.name == 'John Doe')
+    print(f"First query results: {results1}")
+    assert len(results1) == 1
+    
+    # Remove the document
+    db.remove(doc_id=doc_id)
+    
+    # Second query
+    results2 = db.search(User.name == 'John Doe')
+    print(f"Second query results: {results2}")
+    
+    if len(results2) == 0:
+        print("MemoryStorage: Bug not reproduced.")
+    else:
+        print("MemoryStorage: Bug reproduced!")
+        assert len(results2) == 0
+
+def reproduce_json_storage():
+    print("\nTesting JSONStorage...")
+    db_file = 'test_repro.json'
+    db = TinyDB(db_file)
+    User = Query()
+    
+    # Insert a document
+    doc_id = db.insert({'name': 'Jane Doe', 'age': 25})
+    
+    # First query
+    results1 = db.search(User.name == 'Jane Doe')
+    print(f"First query results: {results1}")
+    assert len(results1) == 1
+    
+    # Remove the document
+    db.remove(doc_id=doc_id)
+    
+    # Second query
+    results2 = db.search(User.name == 'Jane Doe')
+    print(f"Second query results: {results2}")
+    
+    if len(results2) == 0:
+        print("JSONStorage: Bug not reproduced.")
+    else:
+        print("JSONStorage: Bug reproduced!")
+        assert len(results2) == 0
+    
+    os.remove(db_file)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        reproduce_memory_storage()
+        reproduce_json_storage()
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Assertion failed: {e}")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"An unexpected error occurred: {e}")
